messages.subject: Saudi Energy & Mining Executive | Government Relations, ESG & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Fahad,

Cube Consult's focus on building leadership teams for Saudi Arabia's next decade, including executive search across energy, oil and gas, mining and infrastructure, aligns closely with my current international search.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications within a major mining environment.

Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership roles where resource development, regulatory strategy, stakeholder trust and responsible growth must operate as one integrated leadership agenda. I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
